sections.title: Choose the word A, B, C or D whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.

questions.html: Question 1. A. fame                 B. chat                 C. traffic                 D. camping
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 1. A. fame                 B. chat                 C. traffic                 D. camping

A. fame /feɪm/: Âm 'a' được phát âm là /eɪ/.

B. chat /tʃæt/: Âm 'a' được phát âm là /æ/.

C. traffic /ˈtræfɪk/: Âm 'a' được phát âm là /æ/.

D. camping /ˈkæmpɪŋ/: Âm 'a' được phát âm là /æ/.

Giải thích: Các phương án B, C, và D có phần gạch chân được phát âm là /æ/. Phương án A được phát âm là /eɪ/.

questions.html: Question 2. A. school          B. food                 C. flood                  D. tool
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 2. A. school         B. food                 C. flood                 D. tool

A. school /skuːl/: Âm 'oo' được phát âm là /uː/.

B. food /fuːd/: Âm 'oo' được phát âm là /uː/.

C. flood /flʌd/: Âm 'oo' được phát âm là /ʌ/.

D. tool /tuːl/: Âm 'oo' được phát âm là /uː/.

Giải thích: Các phương án A, B, và D có phần gạch chân được phát âm là /uː/. Phương án C được phát âm là /ʌ/.

questions.html:
Question 3. The (hard) ________ you study for the exam, the (good) ________ your results will be.

A. harder/good         B. more hard/better                 C. harder/better              D. hard/better
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 3. The (hard) ________ you study for the exam, the (good) ________ your results will be.

A. harder/good         B. more hard/better                 C. harder/better                 D. hard/better

Giải thích: Đây là cấu trúc so sánh kép (double comparative): "The + so sánh hơn + S + V, the + so sánh hơn + S + V" (Càng... thì càng...).

Question 6. My grandparents live in a ________ village, far away from the noisy city.

A. modern                 B. peaceful                         C. fashionable                  D. crowded
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 6. My grandparents live in a ________ village, far away from the noisy city.

A. modern                 B. peaceful                         C. fashionable                 D. crowded

Giải thích: Câu này miêu tả một ngôi làng ở xa thành phố ồn ào. Từ cần điền phải mang ý nghĩa trái ngược với "noisy" (ồn ào).

questions.html:
Question 7. The (interesting) ________ the book is, the (fast) ________ I read it.

A. more interesting/faster                                  B. interestinger/faster

C. more interesting/more fast                                 D. interesting/fast

Question 7. The (interesting) ________ the book is, the (fast) ________ I read it.

A. more interesting/faster                                 B. interestinger/faster

questions.html:
Question 8. Can you show me ________ to get to the nearest post office?

A. where               B. when                      C. how                         D. what
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 8. Can you show me ________ to get to the nearest post office?

A. where                 B. when                         C. how                         D. what

Giải thích: Cấu trúc "show someone + how to do something" có nghĩa là "chỉ cho ai đó cách làm một việc gì đó".

questions.html:
Question 9. I haven't decided ________ to wear to the party tonight.

A. why                 B. what                         C. who                         D. which
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 9. I haven't decided ________ to wear to the party tonight.

A. why                 B. what                         C. who                         D. which

Giải thích: Cấu trúc "decide + what to do" có nghĩa là "quyết định sẽ làm gì". Ở đây, người nói chưa quyết định sẽ mặc cái gì.

questions.html:
Question 10. ________ you pass me the salt, please?

A. Should             B. Must                         C. Might                      D. Could
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 10. ________ you pass me the salt, please?

A. Should                 B. Must                         C. Might                         D. Could

Giải thích: Đây là một lời yêu cầu lịch sự. "Could" là động từ khuyết thiếu thường được dùng để đưa ra yêu cầu một cách lịch sự.

Question 11. A: Can I help you with your bags? - B: ________

A. Not at all.                                                 B. That's very kind of you.

C. I think so.                                                 D. What a pity!
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 11. A: Can I help you with your bags? - B: ________

A. Not at all.                                                 B. That's very kind of you. 

C. I think so.                                                 D. What a pity!

Giải thích: Câu "Can I help you with your bags?" là một lời đề nghị giúp đỡ. Để đáp lại một cách lịch sự và đồng ý, ta dùng một câu thể hiện sự cảm kích.

My family and I had a wonderful trip to the countryside last weekend. We wanted to escape the noisy city for a while. (19)_____. The air was fresh, and the scenery was beautiful with green paddy fields and rolling hills.

On the first day, we went for a long walk. (20) _____. In the evening, we had a barbecue in the garden of our rented cottage. The food was simple but delicious.

The next day, we visited a local farm. (21) _____. We learned a lot about farming and enjoyed the fresh milk. (22) _____. It was a perfect way to relax and reconnect with nature. We all felt refreshed when we returned to the city on Sunday evening.

A. The farmer showed us how to milk the cows.

B. It was a short but memorable trip.

C. So, we decided to visit my grandparents' village.

sections.title: Read and complete each blank in the passage with the correct answer A, B, C or D.
sections.introHtml:
Reading books is one of the best hobbies one can have. It offers numerous benefits that can (23)_____your life in many ways. Firstly, reading is a great way to expand your knowledge. You can learn about different cultures, historical events, scientific discoveries, and much more, all from the comfort of your home.

Secondly, it improves your vocabulary and language skills. When you read, you (24)________ new words and ways of expressing ideas, which can make you a better communicator. It also (25)________ your imagination and creativity. As you read a story, you imagine the characters, settings, and events in your mind.

Finally, reading is a fantastic way to relax and reduce stress. (26)________ yourself in a good book can be a great escape from the pressures of daily life. It provides a peaceful and quiet activity that can calm your mind. So, if you're looking for a hobby that is both enjoyable and (27)________, picking up a book is an excellent choice.

questions.html: Question 23. A. rich                         B. richer                  C. enrich                  D. richness
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 23. A. rich                         B. richer                 C. enrich                 D. richness

Giải thích: Chỗ trống đứng sau động từ khuyết thiếu "can", nên cần một động từ nguyên mẫu. "enrich" là động từ có nghĩa là "làm giàu, làm phong phú".

questions.html: Question 24. A. come across            B. look for                 C. take up                  D. go on
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 24. A. come across                 B. look for                 C. take up                 D. go on

Giải thích: Cụm động từ (phrasal verb) "come across" có nghĩa là "tình cờ bắt gặp", rất phù hợp với ngữ cảnh bắt gặp từ mới khi đọc sách.

questions.html: Question 25. A. damages                 B. limits                  C. prevents                 D. stimulates
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 25. A. damages                 B. limits                 C. prevents                 D. stimulates

Giải thích: Đọc sách giúp phát triển trí tưởng tượng và sự sáng tạo. Động từ "stimulates" có nghĩa là "kích thích, khuyến khích".

questions.html: Question 26. A. Losing                  B. To lose                  C. Lose                  D. Lost
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 26. A. Losing                 B. To lose                 C. Lose                 D. Lost

Giải thích: Chỗ trống đứng đầu câu và làm chủ ngữ, nên cần một danh động từ (Gerund). Cụm từ "Losing yourself in a good book" có nghĩa là "đắm mình vào một cuốn sách hay".

questions.html: Question 27. A. benefit                  B. beneficial                C. beneficiary            D. beneficially
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 27. A. benefit                 B. beneficial                 C. beneficiary                 D. beneficially

Giải thích: Từ "and" nối hai từ có cùng từ loại. "enjoyable" là một tính từ, nên chỗ trống cũng cần một tính từ. "beneficial" là tính từ có nghĩa là "có lợi, hữu ích".

sections.title: Read the following passage and choose the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions.
sections.introHtml:
The world is home to countless wonders, but some landmarks are so iconic they are recognized globally. The Eiffel Tower in Paris, France, is one such structure. Originally built as a temporary exhibit for the 1889 World's Fair, it has become a lasting symbol of French culture. Standing at 330 meters, it offers breathtaking views of the city.

Another famous landmark is the Great Wall of China. This massive series of fortifications was built over centuries to protect Chinese states and empires against raids and invasions. Stretching for thousands of kilometers, it is the world's longest man-made structure and a testament to incredible human effort.

In Egypt, the Pyramids of Giza stand as majestic monuments of the ancient world. Built as tombs for pharaohs, these pyramids, especially the Great Pyramid, are marvels of architectural genius. They have fascinated historians and tourists for thousands of years.

Finally, the Statue of Liberty in New York, USA, is a global symbol of freedom and democracy. A gift from France to the United States, this colossal statue has welcomed millions of immigrants to America. These landmarks, different in their origin and purpose, all share a common trait: they capture the human spirit and inspire awe in all who see them.

questions.html:
Question 28. What is the main idea of the passage?

A. To describe the history of France.

B. To highlight famous and iconic landmarks.

C. To explain how to build large structures.

D. To compare tourism in different countries.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 28. What is the main idea of the passage?

A. To describe the history of France.

B. To highlight famous and iconic landmarks.

C. To explain how to build large structures.

D. To compare tourism in different countries.

Giải thích: Đoạn văn giới thiệu về nhiều địa danh nổi tiếng và mang tính biểu tượng trên khắp thế giới như Tháp Eiffel, Vạn Lý Trường Thành, Kim Tự Tháp Giza và Tượng Nữ thần Tự do. Do đó, ý chính của bài là làm nổi bật các địa danh này

questions.html:
Question 29. The word “breathtaking” in the first paragraph is closest in meaning to

A. boring                 B. normal                 C. amazing                 D. tiring
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 29. The word “breathtaking” in the first paragraph is closest in meaning to

A. boring                 B. normal                 C. amazing                 D. tiring

Giải thích: Câu văn "it offers breathtaking views of the city" có nghĩa là nó mang lại một khung cảnh ngoạn mục của thành phố. "Breathtaking" có nghĩa là đẹp đến mức đáng kinh ngạc, gây ấn tượng mạnh. Từ gần nghĩa nhất là "amazing" (kinh ngạc, tuyệt vời)

questions.html:
Question 30. Why was the Great Wall of China built?

A. To be a tourist attraction.

B. To serve as tombs for emperors.

C. To protect the country from invaders.

D. To be the world's longest road.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 30. Why was the Great Wall of China built?

A. To be a tourist attraction.

B. To serve as tombs for emperors.

C. To protect the country from invaders.

D. To be the world's longest road.

Giải thích: Trong đoạn văn về Vạn Lý Trường Thành, có câu: "This massive series of fortifications was built over centuries to protect Chinese states and empires against raids and invasions." (Loạt công sự khổng lồ này được xây dựng qua nhiều thế kỷ để bảo vệ các quốc gia và đế chế Trung Quốc chống lại các cuộc đột kích và xâm lược.)

questions.html:
Question 31. Which landmark was a gift from one country to another?

A. The Eiffel Tower

B. The Great Wall of China

C. The Pyramids of Giza

D. The Statue of Liberty
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 31. Which landmark was a gift from one country to another?

A. The Eiffel Tower

B. The Great Wall of China

C. The Pyramids of Giza

D. The Statue of Liberty

Giải thích: Đoạn văn nói về Tượng Nữ thần Tự do: "A gift from France to the United States, this colossal statue has welcomed millions of immigrants to America." (Là một món quà từ Pháp cho Hoa Kỳ, bức tượng khổng lồ này đã chào đón hàng triệu người nhập cư đến Mỹ.) .

questions.html:
Question 32. Which of the following is NOT true according to the passage?

A. The Eiffel Tower was intended to be permanent from the start.

B. The Pyramids of Giza were built as tombs for pharaohs.

C. The Statue of Liberty represents freedom and democracy.

D. The Great Wall is the longest man-made structure in the world.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 32. Which of the following is NOT true according to the passage?

A. The Eiffel Tower was intended to be permanent from the start.

B. The Pyramids of Giza were built as tombs for pharaohs.

C. The Statue of Liberty represents freedom and democracy.

D. The Great Wall is the longest man-made structure in the world.

Giải thích: Ta hãy kiểm tra từng phương án:

A. The Eiffel Tower was intended to be permanent from the start. (Tháp Eiffel được dự định là công trình vĩnh viễn ngay từ đầu.) -> Sai. Đoạn văn nói nó "Originally built as a temporary exhibit" (Ban đầu được xây dựng như một vật trưng bày tạm thời).

Question 33. If / you / listen / carefully / you / understand / the lesson.

A. If you listen carefully, you can understand the lesson.

B. If you listens carefully, you might understand the lesson.

C. If you listening carefully, you will understand the lesson.

questions.referenceHtml:
Question 33. If / you / listen / carefully / you / understand / the lesson.

A. If you listen carefully, you can understand the lesson.

B. If you listens carefully, you might understand the lesson.

C. If you listening carefully, you will understand the lesson.

D. If you listened carefully, you could understand the lesson.

Giải thích: Đây là câu điều kiện loại 1. Mệnh đề "If" chia ở thì hiện tại đơn, mệnh đề chính dùng động từ khuyết thiếu (can, will, may...) + động từ nguyên mẫu.

questions.html:
Question 34. The / more / you / practice / English / the / more / fluent / you / become.

A. The more you practice English, the more fluent you may become.

B. The more you practice English, the fluent you become.

C. The more you practice English, the more fluent you will become.

D. More you practice English, the more fluent you will become.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 34. The / more / you / practice / English / the / more / fluent / you / become.

A. The more you practice English, the more fluent you may become.

B. The more you practice English, the fluent you become.

C. The more you practice English, the more fluent you will become.

D. More you practice English, the more fluent you will become.

Giải thích: Đây là cấu trúc so sánh kép. "The more + S + V, the more + adj + S + V".

C. The more you practice English, the more fluent you will become. (Bạn càng luyện tập tiếng Anh nhiều, bạn sẽ càng trở nên lưu loát hơn.) - Câu này đúng cấu trúc và ngữ pháp.

questions.html:
Question 35. If / it / not rain / tomorrow / we / go / to the zoo.

A. If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we might go to the zoo.

B. If it not rain tomorrow, we can go to the zoo.

C. If it won't rain tomorrow, we may go to the zoo.

D. If it don't rain tomorrow, we will go to the zoo.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 35. If / it / not rain / tomorrow / we / go / to the zoo.

A. If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we might go to the zoo.

B. If it not rain tomorrow, we can go to the zoo.

C. If it won't rain tomorrow, we may go to the zoo.

D. If it don't rain tomorrow, we will go to the zoo.

Giải thích: Đây là câu điều kiện loại 1 với mệnh đề "If" ở dạng phủ định. Phủ định của thì hiện tại đơn với chủ ngữ "it" là "doesn't + V(nguyên mẫu)".

questions.html:
Question 36. The / warmer / the weather / is / the / more / comfortable / I / feel.

A. The warm the weather is, the more comfortable I feel.

B. The warmer the weather is, the most comfortable I feel.

C. The warmer the weather is, the more comfortable I feel.

questions.referenceHtml:
Question 36. The / warmer / the weather / is / the / more / comfortable / I / feel.

A. The warm the weather is, the more comfortable I feel.

B. The warmer the weather is, the most comfortable I feel.

Question 37. If you exercise regularly, your health will be better.

A. The regularly you exercise, the better your health will be.

B. The more regular you exercise, the better your health will be.

C. The more you exercise regularly, the better your health will be.

D. The more regularly you exercise, the better your health will be.

Giải thích: Chuyển từ câu điều kiện loại 1 sang cấu trúc so sánh kép.

questions.html:
Question 39. Save some money, and you can buy a new bike.

A. If you saved some money, you could buy a new bike.

B. If you save some money, you can buy a new bike.

C. If you will save some money, you can buy a new bike.

D. You can buy a new bike if you saving some money.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 39. Save some money, and you can buy a new bike.

A. If you saved some money, you could buy a new bike.

B. If you save some money, you can buy a new bike.

C. If you will save some money, you can buy a new bike.

D. You can buy a new bike if you saving some money.

Giải thích: Câu mệnh lệnh "Save some money" theo sau là "and" có thể được viết lại thành câu điều kiện loại 1.

questions.html:
Question 40. Let's visit the museum. We will have an interesting experience.

A. If we visit the museum, we would have an interesting experience.

B. If we will visit the museum, we had an interesting experience

C. If we visit the museum, we have an interesting experience.

D. If we visit the museum, we will have an interesting experience.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 40. Let's visit the museum. We will have an interesting experience.

A. If we visit the museum, we would have an interesting experience.

B. If we will visit the museum, we had an interesting experience

C. If we visit the museum, we have an interesting experience.

D. If we visit the museum, we will have an interesting experience.

Giải thích: "Let's visit..." là một lời đề nghị. Có thể diễn đạt ý này bằng câu điều kiện loại 1 để nói về kết quả nếu thực hiện lời đề nghị đó.
